name: LunR Royalties Corp.
summary: LunR Royalties Corp. operates as a royalty and streaming company in Canada. It has a portfolio of copper, gold, and silver deposits. The company holds royalties on the Los Helados project located in the Region III, Chile; Fruta del Norte project located in the Southeast Ecuador, Ecuador; and Lunahuasi project located in the San Juan Province, Argentina. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
